subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Adaptive Control: Learning on the Fly
description: A 60-second lesson on Adaptive Control: Learning on the Fly.

hook.text: A fixed controller works when the system stays the same. What if the system changes while running?

buildup.text: Adaptive control adjusts its parameters in real time based on observed system behavior.

discovery.text: Model Reference Adaptive Control (MRAC) forces the system to behave like a desired reference model.

twist.text: Adaptation can go wrong if the excitation signal is too weak — the estimator loses track of the true parameters.

climax.text: Fighter jet autopilots adapt to battle damage. Industrial processes adapt to raw material changes.

punchline.text: System shifts, controller follows — adaptation keeps control alive.

quiz.question: What is a key risk in adaptive control systems?
options: They always use too much energy
Insufficient excitation can cause the parameter estimator to lose track
They cannot work with digital controllers
